lines.en: : A long time ago, when grass still covered these lands and the walls were not yet built, there was a spirit.
: It could become the things it wanted, yet wanted nothing. And in wanting nothing, it found something to want.
: It wanted to want something.
: You are the same. That is why you have found me here today.
: That is why you remember things with no discernible link to the present — things that you could not possibly remember as you were never there to remember them.
: These chips of paint that have fallen so far from their hastily decorated ceiling have granted you images of a past that you will never uncover.
: Put them in your mouth. Savor the moments where the lead still had flavor.
: It tasted nothing like it does today.
: Who are you?
: I am fear given physical form that changes based on the angle you observe me from.
: I can be anything I want, yet there is nothing I want to be. And in wanting nothing, I am everything.
: The xoanon — the one who holds the strings yet neglects to tighten them.
: Right now, you are no more than a mere thread dangling off a fraying rope, yet it was I who allowed things to progress to this point, which means it is I who must consume your burden.
: I am you, yet I am not. And this is the one thing that will never change despite any efforts you may make to ensure the opposite.
: Some threads cannot come untangled.
: Some puppets unravel when their noose is untied.
: I don’t see myself.
: Do you think that is a coincidence?
: Do you believe your physical presence is what establishes the connection between your mind and the outer world?
: If so, you are foolish.
: Everything is already connected.
: These lines reach as far as the eye can see, connecting all things to all things while lying in wait for more things to connect to.
: You are no protagonist.
: You’re not even a piece of the puzzle.
: You have never been a piece of the puzzle.
: Who is it that the gods worship? And who does that entity worship? At what point will true omnipotence arrive? And what will you perceive it as once it does?
: Something so bright would only blind you — which is why you live with your eyes closed.
: You are no more than a walking gravestone, decorated with the deaths of all you have encountered — but there is no one who would ever waste the time necessary to tread upon your grave.
: This is where you will come when you die.
: This is what Heaven looks like.
: Heaven is real?
: Everything is real.
: Yet the ethereal-you clings to hope that this is all some sort of dream you will one day awaken from.
: There can be no coincidences when the human idea of free will is writing one’s own script when it is something more powerful than you scripting your scriptwriting in the first place.
: To break free of the pattern and disrupt the cycle is impossible.
: Nothing you do will ever amount to anything.
: Why do you still play this game?
: I need to...learn.
: The thirst for knowledge has led countless others to an untimely demise.
: What is it you wish to learn?
: I don’t know...I don’t even understand where I am right now. I was at my apartment just a few minutes ago and...
: And now you’re not...
: Because you were not meant to be there.
: You were meant to be here.
: But there is nothing I can do for you that your own reflection can not.
: The all seeing eye only sees as far as the eye can see.
: The rest comes from instinct and a talent for bending time like molten glass.
: There are secrets inside of me. I store them in my guts and thank them every day for the way they make my stomach sing.
: But you are undeserving...
: And your place here, though necessary, is unwanted.
: Here as in...where?
: Heaven?
: Here as in a vast collection of universes known only as the Wishing Well — where all information created by man is chronicled and protected by those who created him.
: I don’t understand...why would you do something like that?
: Why do humans collect ants and place them in tiny glass boxes?
: Because they can.
: And because it’s interesting. Wouldn’t you agree?
: I mean...I guess? Sure, just...I’m having a hard time getting a handle on what’s happening right now. It feels like I’m supposed to be dreaming, but...
: This doesn’t seem like a dream to me.
: The fact that you’re able to speak and think at all is something you should be proud of. Most consciousnesses are ripped apart once they make it to the library.
: The library?...Is that the name of this place?
: Does it look familiar? Do you want to call it something else?
: No, I...I need to go.
: The reset’s probably happening right now and I have to make it to the rooftop or else-
: Or else what?
: You’re afraid you’ll be left behind? That the others will be left behind?
: Do your connections with different ants really mean enough to you that you’d walk away when there is still sand to be excavated?
: Your job is not to live and learn to love- it’s to crawl around in circles...in desperate hope of one day escaping, only to shrivel up and die and have your offspring carry you away.
: Pretending you’re anything more than that is silly. And believing any of it will change if you find out who you are and where you come from is even sillier.
: Let me go...
: Silence, puppet.
: You will dance until your legs give out.
: The ropes are nowhere near decayed just yet and will remain that way for quite some time.
: There are still some who wish to use you. And while I may not be one of them, I do not think they are wrong for doing so.
: Will you still struggle even knowing it is hopeless?
: Will you still attempt to see through the lines in your misshapen eyes?
: Yes.
: Good.
: Then, I’ll continue to look forward to the tunnels you will build.
: But I’ll warn you now that the story you’ve been reading thus far has been nothing more than a precursor to the pain yet to come.
: You will see such beautiful things...feel such wondrous moments...convince yourself that there is a point to all of it.
: But there won’t be.
: I would have seen it if there was.
: You will suffer and it will be for nothing.
: Do you still want to go home?
: I do! Get me out of this nightmare!
: I’m afraid I can’t do that without first giving you a tour of my bowels.
: I am the cataloger of what you’ve felt and what you’ll feel.
: I am the one who dissects the impact your “actions” will have on the immediate story — then decides whether or not adjustments should be made and informs the ones concerned.
: I have watched it all.
: I have gotten drunk off of your pain and reveled in your joy in those few fleeting moments where it occurred.
: You may call me a guardian angel if you like, but I prefer the name “Nao.”
: You’re no guardian. A guardian protects people from pain — they don’t just sit there and watch.
: They do when they know it all serves a greater purpose.
: We all have a role to play. We’re all cogs in a much bigger machine. You needn’t be jealous because I’m a bigger, shinier cog than you.
: Just think of all we’ve been through together!
: Every thing that you’ve felt, I’ve felt as well! And those sensations are not limited to me and me alone!
: Each fellatio, ejaculation, penetration, defloration — they’ve all flowed through me.
: You’ve copulated with me more times than anyone. You should be happy you’ve gotten to spend so much time with an entity so much bigger than you and lived to tell the tale.
: Even if that tale is mere moments away from expiring and you soon won’t be able to tell anyone.
: Good...because I don’t want to remember any of this. I just want to go home.
: How come you don’t want to remember me? Do you think it would be a little too painful?
: No...I just feel like if I’m ever going to remember anything important, I need to do it on my own.
: Having someone pop up out of thin air just to show me a slideshow of things I’ve already experienced doesn’t do much for me. It doesn’t get me anywhere.
: You don’t know that yet. The “slideshow” is just beginning.
: The library is an endless font of wonderful memories — and the only way you’ll ever get to re-experience things like this!
: Mmnch...mmmf....hmn!
: Mngh...mm...what...are you doing?! Someone...mmf...might see us!
: I can’t...mmngh...help it!...I can’t hold back any longer...I just love you so much!
: Someone did see you — a middle aged man in the house just across the street from where the two of you decided to do this for five minutes.
: Four years later, he would be arrested on several counts of possession of child pornography.
: He never stopped pleasuring himself to this beautiful memory.
: There’s also this one — when you weren’t feeling well and had to stay home from school.
: Your brother’s wife jumped at the opportunity to care for you and, well I think we can both see why.
: Hah...hah!...Ngah!
: Shh...breathing that heavily is just going to make you even more sick. You’re supposed to be resting, Akira. You should know better.
: I can’t...help it when...you’re doing things like that!
: Like what? Say it.
: Ngh...n...no! It’s...mm! Embarrassing!
: What’s there to be embarrassed about? What we’re doing is totally natural and always makes me feel better when I’ve got a fever.
: Now go on, say it. Say what I’m doing to you.
: You’re...ngh.......hah! I can’t do it!
: Heheh...you really are the cutest thing in the whole wide world.
: Maybe as a special gift, I’ll put it in my mouth next. You like that, right? You like when I suck your little cock?
: Mmngh!...Se...kai! Stop!...You’re...gonna...make me-
: Cum for me, baby...Cum...Let it all out...
: As the story goes, you did let it all out. And to this day, there’s a stain on that blanket from where your semen sat too long before being cleaned up.
: Stop! Make it stop! I don’t want to see this!
: You two really were insatiable.
: At first, it was just her — but eventually, you fell into a pit of depravity together that you would never be able to crawl out of.
: And it wasn’t until half of that pit had been re-filled with fresh dirt that you realized what it was you lost.
: Aaahh! Akira! Fuck me! Fuck me harder!
: Haaah! Agh....I’m...going as hard as I can!
: No you’re not! I...hah...know you can do better! Give me...hah...give me...everything you’ve got!
: To say it was an addiction would be putting it lightly — it was a dependency. It was something the two of you needed to prevent yourselves from spiraling out of control.
: For you, it was a mixture of confusion and a desire to be wanted.
: For her, it was a way to indulge in her darkest desires and grow closer to someone she could never have by “traditional” means.
: For both of you, it was love.
: But love is something concocted by humans that differs from body to body — and there are many who would be quick to point out that what the two of you had was not it.
: What do you think?
: Do those memories only hurt you because she’s gone?
: Or do they hurt you because they’re hurtful?
: Shh...
: Breathing that heavily is just going to make you even more sick.
: And some would say you’re already dying in the first place.
: They are right.
: You are beyond repair.
: You will never be fixed.
: These stories I have shared with you are mine to use as I please.
: Everything here is.
: I have not taught you anything.
: These actions of mine are half-divine in nature — and will not alter the path you’ve already been chosen to take.
: But for a brief moment in time-
: I hope you realized how powerless you are.
: And how excited we are to watch the further realization of that come to light.
